description: List the current in-warehouse deals (instant savings) at one Costco warehouse, from the site's copy of that warehouse's deals: item number, name, discount, regular price, price after the discount, dates, stock and department. Use it to answer "what is on sale at my Costco?". It does not fetch from Costco; status says how fresh the copy is (not_cached means the site has none: checking a receipt for that warehouse fetches them).
name: warehouse_deals
title: Current deals at a Costco warehouse
